Below is a concise list of the **living members of the British Royal Family who are most commonly recognized as “royal”** (those in the line of succession or who hold a royal dukedom or earldom) together with the name of each person’s father.  (Where a father is a monarch or a duke, the title is included for clarity.)

| Member (title) | Father (title) |
|----------------|----------------|
| **King Charles III** | Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh |
| **Queen Camilla** | John McCorquodale |
| **Prince William, Prince of Wales** | King Charles III |
| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | King Charles III |
| **Prince George of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Princess Charlotte of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Prince Louis of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Princess Anne, Princess Royal** | King George VI |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | King George VI |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh)** | King George VI |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs. Edwina Willis** | Prince Andrew |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs. Jack Brooksbank** | Prince Andrew |
| **Peter Phillips** | Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex |
| **Zara Tindall** | Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex |
| **Prince Edward, Duke of Kent** | Prince George, Duke of Kent |
| **Prince Michael of Kent** | Prince George, Duke of Kent |
| **Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester** | Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester |

### Notes

* **King George VI** (1936‑1952) was the father of Princess Anne, Prince Andrew, Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh), Prince Edward, Duke of Kent, and Prince Michael of Kent.  
* **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (1921‑2021) was the father of King Charles III, Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh), and Prince Edward, Duke of Kent (through his marriage to Princess Elizabeth).  
* **John McCorquodale** (1908‑1991) was the father of Queen Camilla (née Camilla Rosemary Shand).  
* **Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester** (1900‑1974) was the father of Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester.  
* **Prince George, Duke of Kent** (1902‑1942) was the father of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent and Prince Michael of Kent.

This table covers all living royals who are either in the direct line of succession or hold a current royal dukedom/earldom.  If you’re interested in extended family members (e.g., the children of the Duke of Kent’s heirs, the grandchildren of the Duke of Gloucester, or the spouses of royals no longer married to a king or queen), just let me know and I can add them.

Below is a concise list of the **living members of the British Royal Family who are most commonly recognized as “royal”** (those in the line of succession or who hold a royal dukedom or earldom) together with the name of each person’s father.  (Where a father is a monarch or a duke, the title is included for clarity.)

| Member (title) | Father (title) |
|----------------|----------------|
| **King Charles III** | Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh |
| **Queen Camilla** | John McCorquodale |
| **Prince William, Prince of Wales** | King Charles III |
| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | King Charles III |
| **Prince George of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Princess Charlotte of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Prince Louis of Wales** | Prince William |
| **Princess Anne, Princess Royal** | King George VI |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | King George VI |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh)** | King George VI |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs. Edwina Willis** | Prince Andrew |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs. Jack Brooksbank** | Prince Andrew |
| **Peter Phillips** | Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex |
| **Zara Tindall** | Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex |
| **Prince Edward, Duke of Kent** | Prince George, Duke of Kent |
| **Prince Michael of Kent** | Prince George, Duke of Kent |
| **Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester** | Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester |

### Notes

* **King George VI** (1936‑1952) was the father of Princess Anne, Prince Andrew, Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh), Prince Edward, Duke of Kent, and Prince Michael of Kent.  
* **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (1921‑2021) was the father of King Charles III, Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh), and Prince Edward, Duke of Kent (through his marriage to Princess Elizabeth).  
* **John McCorquodale** (1908‑1991) was the father of Queen Camilla (née Camilla Rosemary Shand).  
* **Prince Henry, Duke of Gloucester** (1900‑1974) was the father of Prince Richard, Duke of Gloucester.  
* **Prince George, Duke of Kent** (1902‑1942) was the father of Prince Edward, Duke of Kent and Prince Michael of Kent.

This table covers all living royals who are either in the direct line of succession or hold a current royal dukedom/earldom.
